title: Luke Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on Luke 22: the betrayal agreed, the Passover prepared, the supper, the prayer on the Mount of Olives and the arrest.

questions.text: Which feast was approaching at the start of the chapter?
questions.explanation: The feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.

answers.text: The Feast of Booths, kept in Jerusalem
The feast of the new moon in the temple
The feast of unleavened bread, called the Passover
The feast of dedication in Jerusalem

questions.explanation: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.

answers.text: Judas, who was also called Iscariot
Simon Peter
One of the captains of the temple
A servant of the high priest

questions.text: Whom did Jesus send to prepare the Passover?
questions.explanation: Jesus sent Peter and John, telling them to go and prepare the Passover so that they might eat.

answers.text: Judas and Andrew
The master of the house
All twelve apostles together
Peter and John

questions.text: What did Jesus say would happen once they had entered the city?
questions.explanation: He said that when they entered the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water would meet them, and they were to follow him into the house he entered.

answers.text: A lamp burning in an upper window
A man carrying a pitcher of water would meet them
A servant waiting at the city gate
A donkey tied beside the road

questions.text: What did Jesus say as he broke the bread and gave it to them?
questions.explanation: He took bread, gave thanks, broke it and gave it to them, saying, "This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me."

answers.text: "This is the bread of the wilderness"
"Eat, for the hour has come"
"This is my body which is given for you"
"This is the covenant of Moses"

questions.explanation: A dispute arose among them about which of them was considered to be greatest.

answers.text: Who would carry the two swords
Which of them was considered to be greatest
Who would betray him to the priests
Where they should eat the next day

questions.text: What did Jesus tell Peter would happen before the rooster crowed?
questions.explanation: He said that the rooster would by no means crow that day until Peter denied three times that he knew him.

answers.text: Peter would deny three times that he knew him
Peter would fall asleep three times
Peter would be put in prison
Peter would draw a sword against the guards

questions.text: What happened to Jesus' sweat as he prayed in agony?
questions.explanation: Being in agony he prayed more earnestly, and his sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

answers.text: It dried up in the cold wind of the night
It shone like the light of a burning lamp
It fell on the stone beside him and burned
It became like great drops of blood falling on the ground

questions.text: What did Jesus do for the servant of the high priest?
questions.explanation: After one of those with him cut off the servant's right ear, Jesus touched his ear and healed him.

answers.text: He gave him his own cloak
He touched his ear and healed him
He sent him back to the high priest with a message
He told his disciples to bind up the wound

questions.text: What did the men who held Jesus ask after they blindfolded him?
questions.explanation: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, "Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?"

answers.text: "Where are your disciples now?"
"Will you call down fire on us?"
"Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?"
"Tell us where the money is kept"
